title: Company Jobs API output
description: One record per open job, in the same shape for every ATS, plus a per-company report in the run storage.

results.title: Jobs
results.description: Dataset with one row per open job: company, ats, title, department, location, remote, salary, postedAt, apply URL.

report.title: Company report
report.description: Per company: which ATS it uses, how many jobs its board holds, how many were delivered, and the reason when it could not be resolved (FAILED), was never checked (NOT_CHECKED_CAP, NOT_CHECKED_MAX_COMPANIES, NOT_CHECKED_BILLING), was a duplicate board (DUPLICATE_BOARD), or was only partially processed. This is the full list of everything you sent.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Counters for the whole run: companiesAsked (distinct companies you sent), companiesDeduplicated (input lines collapsed into those), companiesProcessed, companiesResolved, companiesFailed, companiesWithNoJobs, companiesNotChecked, companiesOverMaxCompanies, companiesPartiallyProcessed, companiesDuplicateBoards, jobsDelivered, jobsMatched, jobsOverMaxJobsPerCompany, jobsFromDuplicateAnswers (jobs only a second input row for the same board carried, which is what makes jobsDelivered exceed jobsMatched), stopped and stopReason (spending-cap, billing-error or billing-not-active), billingActive, cache hits.
